paite: Huchi in mite tengteng Tui Kongpi mai a om mun lian ah mi khat bang in akikhawmkhawmta ua; TOUPA'N Israel kiang a apiak, Mosi Dan laibu hon tawi ding in laigelhmi Ezra kiang ah thu ahilh uhi.
heading: Ezra In Dan Laibu Asim
english: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.

paite: Siampu Ezra in omkhawmte, pasal leh numei, theihsiamna toh za thei ding tengteng ma ah akha sagihna ani khat ni in dan thu ahon lata hi.
english: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

paite: Pasal leh numeite leh theisiam thei dingte ma ah, zingkhang a kipan sun lai tanpha in Tui Kongpi mai a om mun lian ma ah asimta hi; huchi in mite tengteng in Dan Laibu abildoh chiat uhi.
english: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

paite: Huai ding mah a abawl uh, sing dohkang tung ah laigelhmi Ezra adingh a; asik ah Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah leh Maaseiah, ataklam pang ah adingh ua; aveilam pang ah, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddana, Zekariah leh Meshullam.
english: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

paite: Huchi in Ezra in mite mitmuh in laibu ahong a; mite tunglam ah a-om ngal a; huan ahongta a, mite tengteng adingh uhi:
english: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

paite: Ezra in TOUPA, Pathian thupi avualzawl hi. Huchi in mipi tengteng in adawng ua, "Amen, Amen," chi a akhutte uh lik kawm in alute uh akunsak ua amai ua lei si in TOUPA abia uhi.
english: Then Ezra blessed Yahweh, the great God. All the people answered, “Amen, Amen,” with the lifting up of their hands. They bowed their heads, and worshiped Yahweh with their faces to the ground.

paite: Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah leh Levi mite'n mipite dan theisiam ding in abawl ua: huchi in mite amau mun ah adingh uhi.
english: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.

paite: Huchi in teltak in laibu ah, Pathian dan sung ah asim ua; a-omdan ataklang ua, huchi a lai simkhiak atheihsiamna ding un.
english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.

paite: Huan Nehemiah, amah Tirshatha ahi a, huan siampu leh laigelhmi Ezra, leh Levite mite sinsakte'n, mite tengteng kiang ah, "Tuni TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia ni siangthou ahi; dah kei unla kap kei un," achi ua. Dan thute azak un lah mite tengteng akap ngal ua.
english: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to Yahweh your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

paite: Akiang uah, "Pai unla, thaute ne unla, akhumkhum dawn un, amah a dia bangmah bawlkhol a om lou kiang ah tantuante khak un: tuni lah i TOUPA uh a dia ni siangthou ahi ngal a. Dah kei unla; TOUPA a kipahna na hatna uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”

paite: Huchi in Levite'n mite tengteng adaisak ua, "Tuni siangthou ahih ziak in, dai sipsip unla; dah kei un," chi in.
english: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”

paite: Huan mite tengteng ne ding leh dawn ding leh vualnopna thupi bawl ding in apaita ua, akiang ua phuankhiak a om thute atheisiamta uhi.
english: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.

paite: Ani nih ni in mite tengteng pipute inko lupente, siampute leh Levi mite, laigelhmi Ezra kiang ah, Dan thute ngaikhe ding in akikhawmkhawm uhi.
heading: Biakbuk Ankuangluina
english: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Israel suante akha sagihna ankuangluina a aidakbuk a atendan ding ua thu apiakdan dan a kigelh amu uhi:
english: They found written in the law how Yahweh had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;

paite: "Tang ah kuankhia unla, olive hiang, gam olive leh muising hiang, tum hiang, sing vunsah hiang, akigelh bang a, aidakbuk bawlna ding in va la un, akhopi tengteng uh leh Jerusalem a apuankhiak theihna ding un," achi hi.
english: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, as it is written.”

paite: Huchi in mite akuankhia ua, ava la ua, michih in a-inn tung ah, ahuangsungte uah, Pathian huangsungte ah, Tui Kongpi a mun lian ah leh Ephraim Kongpi a mun lian ah aidakbukte akibawlta uhi.
english: So the people went out and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.

paite: Huan saltanna a kipan hong pai nawn omkhawmte tengteng in aidakbukte abawl ua, aidakbuk ah ateng uhi. Nun tapa Joshua dam lai a kipan huai ni tanpha in Israel suante'n lah huchibang in ahih nai kei uhi. Huchi in nakpi a kipahna mahmah a-omta hi.
english: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.

paite: Huai lou in niteng in ani masapen a kipan ani tawp ni tan in Pathian Dan laibu sung ah asim hi. Huan ankuangluina ni sagih anei ua; ani giat ni in paidan dungzui in kikhopna thupi a-omta hi.
english: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.
